quote: around 1912-1914 in Göttingen, Edmund Landau asked him for 'a physical reason that the Riemann hypothesis should be true,' and Pólya suggested the zeros' imaginary parts might correspond to eigenvalues of a self-adjoint operator
note: The conjecture originated in an informal conversation between Edmund Landau and George Pólya around 1912-1914. The earliest published statement appears in Montgomery (1973). Hilbert's name is associated with it through a story Ernst Hellinger told André Weil, but Hilbert did not actively pose it.
